facts.business: Glittek Granites Limited is transitioning from a dormant granite processing company to a battery energy storage systems (BESS) assembly and integration business, along with advanced materials including rare earth elements and critical minerals, under the proposed new name Rawmin Neo Elements Limited.

segments.name: Advanced materials, rare earth elements, critical minerals (proposed)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Build battery energy storage assembly and integration capability in stages, funded conservatively and commissioned in phases
Change main objects to permit battery energy storage systems, solar photovoltaic cells and modules, and rare earth elements, critical minerals and advanced materials
guidance_or_targets.value: Subject to shareholder approval at AGM

guidance_or_targets.statement: Change company name to Rawmin Neo Elements Limited
Shift registered office to Mumbai from Bangalore

auditor.name: M/s. G R V & P K Chartered Accountants (outgoing); M/s. R. R. Tibrewala & Co. (proposed)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter: non-provision and non-payment of interest on delayed payments to micro and small enterprises, financial impact not quantified

key_risks: Business and demand risk from low operating volumes and dependence on construction and real-estate activity
Execution risk in restarting or scaling granite operations and implementing proposed BESS project
Funding and liquidity risk associated with proposed capital-intensive diversification
Technology and supply-chain risk relating to battery cells, equipment, warranties, safety standards and rapid technological change
Regulatory and compliance risk across company law, securities law, environmental, land, labour, taxation, foreign trade and sector-specific approvals
Commodity, freight, foreign-exchange and counterparty-credit risks
Information-security and cyber risk affecting systems, data and business continuity
Health, safety and environmental risks inherent in industrial and project operations
facts.related_party_note: No specific related party transactions disclosed in excerpts; new promoters (Rawmin group) acquired control via share purchase agreement and open offer
